name: OOF The Goldmine Planet

features.name: Sticky wins
features.description: Winning symbols stick and pay on every following free spin.

review:
A cosmic 10-liner with galaxy symbols and one of the nicest bonuses for building steadily. Three Saturn scatters start free spins.

In the bonus, every winning symbol sticks and pays again on every following spin, and new paying symbols stick too – so wins compound as the round goes on. Free spins come round often, about once every 96 spins. Medium-low volatility, 5,000x max and 97% RTP. Easy to love.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 96 spins on average)
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
